transitions: I experienced the environments where IT is used, learning the importance of user support and communication.
After practical IT work, I began studying programming and computing fundamentals, moving toward understanding technology through code.
My focus expanded from basic coding to data structures and computer architecture, including the internal processes behind results.
I moved from concepts to implementation, experiments and deployment, checking understanding through tests and observations and connecting my learning in a website.
